s:
Which of the following statements about the Arya Samaj which emerged in the late 19th century are correct?

I. Had a strong supporting base amongst the trading castes.

II. Introduced ‘Shuddhi’ or mass purification.

s:
Which of the following statement(s) about the social base of the Arya Samaj in British India is/are correct?

I. It was located mainly in Punjab and Western Uttar Pradesh.

II. It mainly comprised the trading castes.
